candidate_evidence.quote: This is a Phase 1, open-label, multicenter clinical study evaluating ERAS-801 as a monotherapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study to Evaluate ERAS-801 in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma (THUNDERBBOLT-1)

role_evidence.quote: ERAS-801 will be orally administered to study participants with recurrent GBM in sequential ascending doses until unacceptable toxicity, disease progression, or withdrawal of consent.

source_quote.quote: ERAS-801 will be orally administered at the recommended dose (as determined from Part 1) to study participants with recurrent GBM harboring alterations in EGFR.
